`combined-data.zarr.json` is the unmodified metadata from the user's R2
`whirlwind-hindsight/hindsight/data/zarr.json`, recorded 2026-10-07. Tigris
served identical metadata. It describes the shared seven-parameter array;
the reader tests independently check its shard/inner-chunk offsets and size.
No credentials or weather shard payloads are stored in this fixture.
